summary: Validated the revise-acknowledgement bug fix end-to-end. Backend: 7/7 pytest cases green (added a dedicated TestReviseAcknowledgement class that submits a kind='revise' turn with substantively different content and asserts (a) HTTP 200, (b) 6 turns in the correct sequence, (c) the AI invitation does not contain any of ~11 deny-revision phrases (haven't revised / no revision / same as before / etc.), (d) developmental_movement is non-empty and not 'initial' and does not deny the change, and (e) current_student_writing is populated. Also strengthened TestSecondInteract to check that a kind='answer' reply is NOT misread as a new draft. Frontend: full Playwright flow from Teacher Setup → Begin Session → first writing turn → first AI invitation → select reply-mode-revise → send revised text via the thread's send-reply-button → second AI invitation. The second invitation explicitly acknowledged the change ("You've made a real structural leap here — the previous draft stacked 'also…also…also' complaints, and now you've opened with a governing claim ('make the core more livable')...") and dev panel showed direct_evidence quotes lifted verbatim from the revised draft. All three reply modes (answer/explain/revise) render as buttons with the expected data-testids. Single-page navigation confirmed — URL never changed. Dev panel open/close works via open-dev-panel-button and close-dev-panel-button. Fix is verified.

rca of the issue: Original bug (iteration_1 → post-hoc report): the coach denied a revision that had clearly happened. Root cause was two-part: (1) pasted revisions submitted via the thread arrived as kind='answer' and _build_prompt treated them as verbal replies, so the model never compared them to the previous draft; (2) even for kind='writing'/'revise'/'continue', the prompt did not explicitly show PREVIOUS DRAFT vs CURRENT DRAFT, so the model had to infer it from raw turn history and sometimes concluded no revision occurred. Fix (verified this iteration): (a) UI now exposes an explicit 'revise' reply mode that sends kind='revise' from the thread; (b) _build_prompt now, for any kind in DRAFT_KINDS, emits a labeled CURRENT DRAFT block, a labeled PREVIOUS DRAFT block, and an explicit instruction ('Compare the CURRENT DRAFT to the PREVIOUS DRAFT literally... Never tell the student they have not revised when the current draft differs from the previous one'); (c) SYSTEM_MESSAGE carries a parallel non-negotiable rule. Reproduction/mitigation confirmed: the automated Playwright run above submitted a genuinely restructured revision via reply-mode-revise, and the coach's response opened with 'You've made a real structural leap here — the previous draft stacked also…also…also complaints, and now you've opened with a governing claim...' — direct acknowledgement of the change.
